project_type: Multi-starter monorepo with 52 independent Next.js/Astro/Django/Expo/etc projects
build_system: pnpm workspaces at root for catalog validation only; each starter is fully independent with its own pnpm manifest and lockfile
test_framework: Vitest + fast-check for property tests; each starter has tests/ directory with unit/, integration/, property/, and smoke/ subdirs
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install in starter dir, 2. pnpm lint, 3. pnpm typecheck, 4. pnpm test, 5. pnpm build
snapshot_or_generated_files: pnpm-lock.yaml is committed per starter. Prisma generates @prisma/client at install time. Drizzle migrations are committed.
setup_instructions: Each starter: cp .env.example .env.local, pnpm install, then run db:push/db:migrate for schema
environment_constraints: Internet access available. Node LTS available. pnpm available.
contribution_requirements: Each starter must: pin exact dependency versions, have .env.example with placeholder values, have README documenting all setup, have starter.json matching catalog entry, have comprehensive tests including Property 4 (auth consistency) and Property 5 (webhook authenticity), pass standalone validation (copy folder, install, test, build without root access)

key_patterns.directory_structure: app/ (Next.js pages/routes), domain/ (entities.ts, policies.ts), lib/server/ (adapters, config, errors, fakes), tests/ (unit/, integration/, property/, smoke/), drizzle/ or prisma/ (schema + migrations)
key_patterns.adapter_pattern: Interface (XxxPort) in xxx.ts, fake implementation in xxx-fake.ts, real implementation also in xxx.ts. Config boundary in config.ts with aggregate validation.
key_patterns.auth_pattern: middleware.ts for route protection, lib/server/auth.ts for auth adapter, domain/policies.ts for RBAC/authorization
key_patterns.test_pattern: Property 4 tests auth consistency with fast-check; Property 5 tests webhook verification with random payloads. Integration tests cover actions and auth flows.
key_patterns.billing_pattern: BillingPort interface with createCheckout, verifyWebhook, handleWebhookEvent. FakeBillingAdapter uses string match for valid secret. WebhookVerificationError thrown on invalid.
key_patterns.env_pattern: .env.example with placeholder values grouped by provider, .gitignore excludes .env.local
key_patterns.starter_json: Must match catalog entry: id, folder, family, useCase, framework, runtime, technologies array, auth, data, monetization, integrations array

relevant_files: nextjs-b2b-saas/ (reference for Drizzle + webhook + RBAC pattern)
nextjs-supabase-saas/ (reference for Stripe + Resend + Prisma-like pattern)
directory_structure: Root: catalog/, scripts/, tests/, .kiro/, package.json, README.md, and 52 starter folders. Each starter is self-contained with its own package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and full source.
